title: the per-field source record dropped the document identity
baseline_reproduction: code_audit/run42_baseline_state_chrono.json: signal_inputs.sources.ev == {docType, value} only, while source_documents carried document_id and sha256 for the same period; evidence_qualification.provenance_evidence.fields_with_document_identity_and_version == 0 of 7
root_cause: extraction_merge built each per-field sources entry as {docType, value}, discarding the document_id, sha256, revision_of and as_of that emit_observations puts on every observation. qualification._provenance requires BOTH a document identity and a version, so it counted zero on every project ever computed and provenance was structurally pinned to PARTIAL; _timeliness was pinned the same way by the missing asOf.
fix: server/app/extraction_merge.py: new _source_entry(w) carries documentId, documentVersion (the content-addressed sha256), asOf and revisionOf; keys omitted rather than nulled when the observation does not carry them. server/app/simulation/qualification.py: the PARTIAL reason sentence is no longer emitted beside a PASS.
regression_evidence: run42 suite section 5 (7 of 7 fields traced, provenance and timeliness PASS for all four periods); fault F1 and F4 both caught; code_audit/run42_v26_v27_execution_proof.csv rows MERGE_SOURCES, MERGE_SOURCE_KEYS, QUAL_TRACED_FIELDS

title: the qualification record named a null project
baseline_reproduction: code_audit/run42_baseline_state_chrono.json: evidence_qualification.project_id == null for every period, while reporting_period was correctly 'P3'
root_cause: compute.py read project_id from si.get('projectId') or si.get('id'); the signal-inputs dict is extraction_merge._KEY_ORDER, the reported figures, and has neither key. The read path in documents._result_view hard-coded project_id=None. Both callers held the project the whole time.
fix: server/app/simulation/compute.py: compute_project takes an explicit project_id and uses it as the fallback. server/app/documents.py: run_and_store passes project.legacy_id; _result_view takes project_legacy_id and passes it to qualification_for_stored_result. server/app/training.py: the training view passes its project too.
regression_evidence: run42 suite section 4 (route level) and section 7 (compute boundary, direct); faults F2 and F3 both caught. F2 was invisible to the route-level sections because the read path re-derives the record, which is why section 7 exists.

title: ten declared extraction fields are consumed by nothing
baseline_reproduction: code_audit/run42_unconsumed_extraction_fields.csv: 10 of 118 declared extraction fields appear nowhere in server/app outside their declaration
root_cause: the extractor is asked for these fields and their values are stored on Document.extraction, but no observation, no signal input and no module reads them. There is no 'intended module input' they fail to reach -- there is no destination declared for them at all.
fix: NONE. Mapping them to module inputs would be designing new analytical inputs, which is a scientific change and not a mechanism repair. Reported for an owner decision rather than acted on.
regression_evidence: code_audit/run42_unconsumed_extraction_fields.csv, derived by a differential test (remove one declared field, re-emit, compare) cross-checked against a whole-tree reference search

title: A4.1 neither computes nor abstains
baseline_reproduction: code_audit/run42_category_disposition.csv: A4.1 appears in registry_index() but in neither module_results nor abstained
root_cause: run_module('A4.1') raises MissingModuleError: the module has not been ported and validated against the JavaScript implementation and the server deliberately refuses to compute it.
fix: NONE. This is a deliberate fail-closed refusal, not a loss in the period-binding path.

title: D1.1 to D1.5 do not appear on a single-project compute
baseline_reproduction: code_audit/run42_category_disposition.csv: D1 shows 0 computed, 0 abstained, 5 not reached
root_cause: Portfolio Health is portfolio scope; the registry refuses group D on a single-project path. The portfolio snapshot is computed separately and IS present on the stored result.
regression_evidence: code_audit/run42_category_disposition.csv; portfolio_snapshot present on the same result
